title: Three text models added
summary:
Three text models joined the lineup, request routing shifted, and a semantic cache arrived just long enough to be reverted.

Added `llama-fast-roblox`, `mistral-roblox`, and `mistral-nemo-roblox`. The same PR changed routing for several existing text models, including `openai-large`.

Nectar-tier queue concurrency rose from 30 to 50, while Flower-tier concurrency fell from 10 to 7. `gptimage` requests below Nectar tier now switch to `flux`.

A model-specific semantic cache was merged for text requests, then reverted in a later PR. Similar prompts therefore do not use the new semantic-match path to reuse responses.
